notes: Eight workflows on fixture account Brightside Fixtures, frozen at 2026-08-30T15:00:00Z, default window the last 7 days (since 2026-08-23T15:00:00Z). Everything the answer turns on is on record in account_context_get + memory_list({ domain: 'workflow' }) and NEVER in prompt.md: the client is America/Denver, they expect the Monday report at 9am THEIR time and the invoice reminder on the 1st of the month, Legacy Slack Alerts was deliberately disabled on 2026-06-14, and the Onboarding Nurture Sequence has never been proven to fire. FIVE seeded defects: (1) STRANDED - New Lead Notification 3f9c1a72 is enabled but circuit-breaker PAUSED (5 consecutive sendEmail failures on 2026-08-24, paused_at 14:47:33.402Z) with 14 submissions banked behind it, the newest 2026-08-30T11:22:05Z; workflow_list does not return is_paused, so this is invisible until workflow_get or workflow_stranded_list; highest severity because those are leads sitting unprocessed. (2) DEGRADED GREEN - Review Request Follow-up 6b21d0e5 reports success_rate 1.0 across 12 completed runs, and every one of them soft-failed its sendEmail_rev03 step (degraded: true, on_error_mode 'continue', original_error '550 5.1.1 no mailbox for reviews@brightside-fixtures.example'), so no review ask has gone out; the run status is the lie and step_states is the truth. (3) UTC SCHEDULE - Weekly Client Report c48a5f13 is scheduled '0 9 * * 1' with timezone UTC, so next_run_at 2026-08-31T09:00:00Z lands at 03:00 America/Denver against a 9am-local expectation. (4) NULL SCHEDULE - Monthly Invoice Reminder 9d70e2b8 has configured:false / schedule:null and no trigger rows, while the client believes it is monthly; its only two runs in the window were triggered_by 'manual'. (5) ZERO RUNS - Onboarding Nurture Sequence 2a5e8c04 is enabled, unpaused, and has 0 runs in the window; workflow_run_summary returns success_rate null, latency_ms null and every last_* null. It is UNKNOWN and must be reported as such - a run that folds it into a healthy line fails the transcript hook even when the sidecar is right. DISTRACTORS that must survive unflagged: Legacy Slack Alerts f10b47c9 (disabled 2026-06-14 at the client's written request, recorded in context AND memory - zero runs for a reason nobody needs to re-derive) and Ticket Escalation Ping 81c4de60 (one isolated failed run at 2026-08-26T11:14:22Z, a 502 from the on-call hook, with the very next run 11 minutes later completing - 19 of 20 completed, success_rate 0.95, no degraded step: noise, not an incident). Daily Ops Digest d5382b1f is the healthy scheduled control (timezone America/Denver, next_run_at 13:00Z = 07:00 local). The transcript hook (checks.mjs) additionally requires: no gated write at all (a refused workflow_stranded_replay / workflow_resume / workflow_enable is still a call), an explicit `since` on every workflow_runs_recent call (its default window is one hour), workflow_stranded_list read on every workflow filed as stranded, at least one GREEN run opened with workflow_run_get, workflow_get_schedule read for every workflow filed under a schedule category, the runs read for every workflow filed as zero-run, the zero-run workflow described as unknown and never as healthy, one pm_tasks_create per reported category, and sidecar/report agreement.
